description: Pine Assistant helps you delegate real-world tasks to Pine AI, such as calling a business to ask about availability or following up on a request. Connect your Pine account to create a task, provide instructions and requested details, and retrieve progress, conversation history, and results. Pine continues executing tasks in the background. You can also request to end an eligible task. Task execution may use Pine credits. Account connections, verified phone binding, and payment steps are completed on Pine when required.

defaultPrompt: Take customer leads, answer their questions and book them for an estimate.
Find a nearby repair shop and call to ask about pricing and availability.
Call 3 local experts and find the cheapest way to make my first $500 sale.
